items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: I know Jelly Roll. I heard Jelly Roll all the time.

ctx.x: Zutty, you know, started telling me about it. I know Jelly Roll. I heard Jelly Roll all the time.
Yes. Well why, why was it that these guys who were sort of good musicians etc., were pimps as well? I mean, how did they get into that?
